name: Texture-Based Splat Storage Preprocessing
definition: Preprocesses parsed Gaussian splat data into 8 separate RGBA32F textures for Niagara rendering: Position, Scale, Rotation, Color, HarmonicsL1, HarmonicsL2, HarmonicsL31, HarmonicsL32.
summary: Texture-Based Splat Storage Preprocessing converts Gaussian splat data into eight uncompressed 32-bit floating-point textures to enable high-precision, on-demand loading in Unreal Engine, distinguishing itself by avoiding byte-level compression.
